content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to perform a task that I thought would be simple. I have two analog inputs (A1 and A2), and I need to calculate the difference (A1 - A2 = ax), which could result in a negative value. My goal is for the output Q to be active when the difference is between -10 and +10. It seems like a 'compare in zone' operation, but I can't find a function for this in [product_name] software. Appreciate any assistance. Regards, [user_name]
You can use an analog comparator for this application.
Hello, thank you for your help. However, I can’t open the file (difference) because my software version is [product_name] V6.0. Regards, [user_name]
This is exactly what I need (see attached image). Thank you.

It appears you haven't installed the latest service pack, which is why you're unable to open the file. If you can't update right now, I've provided the program again in a compatible format. You should be able to open this one.
Thank you very much, it works perfectly. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user had difficulty configuring a 'compare in zone' function to determine whether the difference between two analog inputs fell within a set range, due to the lack of an explicit function in [product_name] software and incompatibility between file versions. A solution using an analog comparator was suggested, but a compatible file had to be provided for the user's older software version. The approach worked after sharing a suitable file format.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the software to include an out-of-the-box 'compare in zone' function and to be able to open shared project files regardless of minor version differences.
